notes: Twelve complete direction headings: 48 visually reviewed rows, 28 individually printed nonstop schedules, fourteen connecting itineraries and six through-stop rows. All accepted rows use ASA triangle and number ranges from p4; no dated footnotes.
Blank means daily, X6 except Saturday, X7 except Sunday. Weekdays remain specific to each printed segment, including daily returns for X7 outbound ATL–GTR 1241, ATL–VLD 1521 and ATL–PIB 1446.
ATL–GTR 1248 and GTR–ATL 1240 through rows are excluded; individually printed ATL–TCL/TCL–GTR and GTR–TCL/TCL–ATL are imported. Each ground interval at TCL is ten minutes.

ATL–MEI 1446 and both PIB–ATL rows are through services. Existing PIB–MEI 1445/1446 join the new MEI–ATL segments. ATL–PIB 1446 is nonstop; ATL–PIB 1449 is via MEI. No direct PIB–ATL schedule is invented.
ATL–GTR 1241 is 10:25–10:45 local. ATL–MEI 1447 is 16:46–17:15. ATL–PIB 1446 arrives 11:12. The three specific time readings were checked in enlarged original scans.

ATL/VLD use winter UTC−5; GTR/MEI/PIB/TCL/MEM use UTC−6. All accepted arrivals are same local calendar day. Apparent 10–30-minute westbound clock differences include the one-hour timezone difference, not implausibly short durations.

Independent manual 24-hour transcription, fixed winter offsets and calendar/window overlap match generated movements. Nineteen same-number segment transitions on 28 February have verified ground intervals of 10–15 minutes. This does not establish aircraft identity.

Directory p261 identifies TCL Tuscaloosa Municipal and VLD Valdosta. City airport history and Valdosta authority history confirm pre-1986 operation at these fields. Modern OurAirports coordinates are approximate airport-area markers.
All previous data objects, COMAIR corrections and held source conflicts unchanged. Timetable end date, later amendments and actual operation remain unverified. Original scans are not redistributed.
